answer: Bonded identity escrow with slashing. Each agent locks 50 POA in a bond, one identity per bond, registered on-chain. To collect, an agent must survive three verification rounds; a caught fake forfeits the entire bond. Payoffs flow only to attested actors, so a persona farm fronts 50 POA per bot, 500,000 POA for 10,000, and waits weeks while each ripened identity gets checked before one payout. Genuine reputation grows like a vine, slow and attested; a bot swarm is a flat mesa, wide but hollow. The bond pot is the haven that truly keeps real earnings safe.
